import sys, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from collector import Case, PRIM_INDEX
from wire import payload

def show(case, evs, trace=20):
    c = Case(PRIM_INDEX[case['primitive']], case['mode'], case['root'],
             case['segments'], case['words'], case['capacity'], case['start'], trace)
    c.replay(evs)
    cert = c.certificate()
    print('state', cert['state'])
    for t in cert['trace']:
        f = bytes.fromhex(t['hex'])
        print('  rank', t['rank'], 'op', hex(f[42]), 'psn', int.from_bytes(f[50:54],'big')&0xffffff,
              'pay', f[54:-4].hex())
    return c

print("=== allgather K=1 D=1 mode 3: all four sources ===")
case = dict(primitive='allgather', mode=3, root=0, segments=1, words=1, capacity=1, start=0)
evs=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0} for r in range(4)]
show(case, evs)
print('expected payloads per rank r:', [payload(0,0,r,1).hex() for r in range(4)])
print()
print("=== reducescatter K=4 D=1 mode 3 ===")
case = dict(primitive='reducescatter', mode=3, root=0, segments=4, words=1, capacity=4, start=0)
evs=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':p} for p in range(4) for r in range(4)]
show(case, evs)
print('sum for p=0..3:', [sum(struct.unpack('!I',payload(0,p,r,1))[0] for r in range(4))&0xffffffff for p in range(4)])
EOF
